crossRefs.note: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
Yahweh’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
Only know for certain that, if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on…

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
translations.bsb: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
translations.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
translations.asv: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
